about: Issue #78: where the data of the public library comes from (scripts/library_collect.py reads this; docs/PUBLIC_LIBRARY.md). models: one robot model per entry, from a GitHub repository at a pinned commit (urdf, xacro, or a URDF inside an archive of the repository) or from the private model folder (private). local_models: a model taken out of an archive in the materials folder. packages: a repository at a pinned commit as GitHub's source archive. local: a file of the materials folder (root materials) or of the page captures (root extra). skipped: brands and models of the catalogue with no public model, and why. licence_name empty = the source has no licence file (internal reference only).

models.research_notes: Doubtful: a third-party RobotAC competition kit built on MATRiX that bundles the vendor's xgw2 model (robot name just 'DOG'). MATRiX docs call xgw2 the 'second wheeled XG variant'. Identifying it as L2-W is my inference: link names and leg lengths match the private L2-U URDF (xg2_wheel_ULTRA), which is about 2 kg heavier. URDF points to ../meshes/*.STL, but the 17 STL files sit in xgw2/assets/, so the packer must rewrite the paths. The LICENSE file reads 'Copyright (c) 2025, ZsiBot' (BSD-3-Clause).
models.notes: 取自一个比赛仓库（xgw2/xg_wheel_2.urdf，许可证写着 ZsiBot 版权）；按连杆名称和腿长与 L2-U 的厂家文件对得上推断是 L2-W，不是厂家直接发布的。

Official ANYbotics 'simple' description. Commit is master head; robot_descriptions.py pins 6adc147..., same URDF and meshes (only package.xml differs).

Official ARX model repo, no licence file. ARX names the package X5A; mujoco_menagerie arx_l5 states the ARX L5 is derived from this X5/X5A URDF, and its wrist offsets match arx5-sdk models/L5.urdf. Official Yaskawa. No licence file (package.xml BSD-3-Clause). HC10DT / HC10DT B10 / HC10DTP B00 variants are also in motoman_hc10_support/urdf/.

Only hardware_type:=gz_classic needs interbotix_xsarm_sim / interbotix_common_sim (other repos). main branch is ROS 1.
Official. Same notes as vx300s.
Official. Plain URDF, mesh paths relative ('assets/...'). Repo is large (CAD/STEP files): fetch only Simulation/SO100 and LICENSE.

Official. Follower arm, new calibration (the LeRobot default); also so101_old_calib.urdf, so101_leader_new_calib.urdf, so101_new_calib_camera.urdf and MJCF so101_new_calib.xml. assets/ also holds Onshape .part files that the URDF does not use.

models.research_notes: MJCF only; no public URDF (apptronik GitHub account has no repos). meshdir=assets, all meshes present. Repo is large; fetch only the apptronik_apollo folder. Licence is per model folder (repo-level NOASSERTION).

Community repo (listed in awesome-robot-descriptions), no licence; Agility publishes no URDF. Meshes are referenced as package://urdf/*.obj, i.e. the urdf/ folder itself (with .mtl files). Joints are 'continuous' (22) with closed-chain rods; this is the Digit v3-era model, not the 2023+ head/hands version.
models.notes: 社区仓库，没有许可证；是旧版 Digit（v3）的模型，不是现在带新头部和手的版本。闭链的连杆没有闭合。

models.research_notes: Official PNDbotics repo. adam_license.txt is BSD-3-Clause text (GitHub shows NOASSERTION). Relative meshes/*.dae refs, all 27 present; MJCF adam_lite/adam_lite.xml uses adam_lite/assets OBJ. README warns about the toe collision orientation. Repo is large; fetch only adam_lite/. MJCF also in mujoco_menagerie/pndbotics_adam_lite (MIT).

Tag v2.0.0, same commit as robot_descriptions.py; later tag v2.1.0 (master) keeps only xacro for the full model. package://talos_data/meshes/... -> repo root; all 48 present (subfolders arm, gripper, head, torso, v2, sensors). Also urdf/talos_full_v2.urdf and talos_reduced.urdf. PAL's xacro: pal-robotics/talos_robot.

Official, master (ROS 1; jazzy-devel branch exists at 6f7d56ccef6f78061925c56c6bd9d134d243f911). No args; includes $(find op3_description)/urdf/*.xacro (structure, visuals, inertia, gazebo, transmissions). package://op3_description/meshes/*.stl, all 21 present. MJCF in mujoco_menagerie/robotis_op3.

Official vendor assets repo. Mesh refs are relative (meshes/*.STL), all 25 present. Same folder also has T1_29dof.urdf, T1_locomotion.urdf and MJCF. robot_descriptions.py uses the older booster_gym/resources/T1/T1_serial.urdf instead.
Official vendor assets repo, same commit as T1. Relative mesh refs, all 24 present. K1_locomotion.urdf and MJCF also in robots/K1.

Official, branch FourierN1 (same commit as robot_descriptions.py). The LICENSE at this commit is Apache-2.0, although GitHub reports GPL-3.0 for the repo (that is the master branch). Mesh refs ../meshes/*.STL, all 29 present. N1_rotor.urdf is a variant with rotor inertia.

Official, master. GRX/GR1/README.md maps product GR-1 to code name GR1T1 (GR1T2 = GR-1 Pro). Mesh refs ../meshes/gr1t1/*.STL, all 35 present. With-hand variant: GRX/GR1/gr1t1/urdf/gr1t1_fourier_hand_6dof.urdf. robot_descriptions.py pins an older commit (351245ac) whose GRX/GR1/GR1T1 paths no longer exist on master.

Official, master; the 2025-11 commit says this is the most recent GR2 URDF. Mesh refs ../meshes/gr2v3_8_7/*.STL, all 31 present; MJCF in GRX/GR2/gr2v3_8_7/mjcf. Alternatives: GRX/GR2/GR2v3.0.1/urdf/GR2v3.0.1.urdf (master), or branch FourierGR2 @ 9ad42d37cb9c91be5db3c52a8c5d2c0e39981a0c GR2/urdf/GR2_raw.urdf whose LICENSE is Apache-2.0.

Link-U-OS is AgiBot's robot-OS org; README calls it Raise A2 open-sourced by Agibot (robot name a2_t2d0_ultra). Complete and self-contained (relative ../meshes refs, all 91 present), but only the 12 leg joints are revolute; arms, waist and head are fixed. A 22-DoF model_public.urdf exists in Link-U-OS/rl_deploy @ 2f6f2f4d2a7058e527e15882fa32539baafa13a5 (mujoco_sim/resource/model/a2_t2d0_ultra/urdf/) but its meshes/convex collision folder is not in that repo. A community copy (Seb-project/Agibot-A2-path-tools, no licence) is missing 2 meshes.
models.notes: 智元 Link-U-OS 的远征 A2 模型，只有腿部 12 个关节能动，手臂、腰、头是固定的。

models.research_notes: Official. v1.4.0 is the current X2 Ultra ('X2 Ultra -N' nameplate); v1.3.0/x2_ultra.urdf is the earlier X2 Ultra and v1.4.0/X2-EDU.urdf the EDU variant. Mesh refs ./meshes/*.stl, all 40 present. Careful when packing: meshes/meshes is a symlink to '.' (loop).

Community repo (not AgiBot); licence is the uploader's. Meshes are FBX, which many URDF tools cannot load. The xacro includes ./left_arm, right_arm, left/right_omnipicker xacros and uses package://${pkg_name}/urdf/g1/meshes/*.fbx with pkg_name=g1_robot_description (package.xml says agibot_g1_description) -> repo root; all refs present. Do not use its prebuilt urdf/G1_omnipicker.urdf: 11 of 30 meshes missing. Official G1 URDFs in AgibotTech/genie_sim reference genie_robot_description FBX meshes that are not published.
models.notes: 社区仓库（不是智元发布的），许可证是上传者写的；网格是 FBX，仿真读不了。

models.research_notes: Official (UBTECH-Robot org). README: model is for Walker S2 EDU and is the official GHRC 2026 sim model. Version with 3rd-gen dexterous hands; relative meshes/*.STL refs, all 59 present. Gripper variant: walker_s2_with_gripper_urdf/walker_s2.urdf (38 meshes, all present). Repo is large mainly because of USD files. OpenAtom Open Hardware License has no SPDX id (file header also says 'Version 0.4.3').

Official UBTECH repo whose README names it the Walker TienKung URDF package; files are the Tiangong 2.0 Pro model (package tiangong2pro_urdf = repo root, all 37 meshes present). 30 revolute joints, while press gives 20 DoF for Walker TienKung, so check the variant. With hands: urdf/tiangong2.0_pro_with_hands.urdf. A DEX variant is in UBTECH-Robot/Walker_TienKung_DEX_URDF; X-Humanoid's own models are in Open-X-Humanoid/TienKung_URDF (~440 MB). Licence has no SPDX id.

models.research_notes: Official, no licence file. Meshes are referenced as package://resource/robot/pm01_edu/meshes/*.dae, i.e. strip 'package://resource/robot/' to get the repo path; all 25 present (OBJ copies also in the folder). Robot engineai_pm01, 24 revolute joints (README: PM01 v2 Edu). A BSD-3-Clause alternative: engineai-robotics/engineai_ros2_workspace @ 42c0f1227058adb55b0455bd1b724e5428c91448, src/simulation/mujoco/assets/resource/robot/pm_v2/urdf/serial_pm_v2.urdf (STL).

Official Galbot org. Named 'Galbot One Golf'; matching it to G1 is my inference from its structure (omni chassis, lifting leg, two 7-DoF arms, grippers, head) and the org's only other model being S1. Visual meshes are GLB (not supported by every URDF loader), collision STL; relative refs, all 118 present. Fixed-wheel variant urdf/galbot_one_golf_fixed_base.urdf; MJCF (OBJ meshes) in mjcf/.
models.notes: 官方仓库名叫 Galbot One Golf，按结构（全向底盘、升降腿、两条 7 自由度臂、夹爪、头）推断就是 G1。可视网格是 GLB，仿真读不了。

models.research_notes: Official Leju org. Kuavo hardware version S54 (newest in this repo; kuavos53 also present). Relative ../meshes refs, all 33 present. Official alternative LejuRobotics/kuavo-ros-opensource (MIT) is about 4.7 GB.
Official RobotEra org (roboterax). 29-DoF L7 with neck fixed. Relative ../meshes refs, all 49 present. MJCF: deploy/l7_29dof_neck_fixed/l7_29dof_neck_fixed.xml.
Official RobotEra repo; README calls it the STAR1 URDF (55 DoF incl. hands, robot name 'l3'). Relative ../meshes refs, all 77 present.
